crossRefs.note: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to…
Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: When we heard this, we and the people there pleaded with Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And when we heard these things, both we and they of that place besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
